name: GL Account Group Report
query:
SELECT 
    acc.report_type AS "Report Type:Data:200",
    t.gl_account AS "GL Account:Data:200",
    gm.primary_group AS "Primary Group:Data:180",
    gm.secondary_group AS "Secondary Group:Data:220",
    SUM(t.uploaded_amount) AS "Amount:Currency:150",
    t.month AS "Month:Data:120",
    t.fiscal_year AS "Fiscal Year:Data:120",
    t.company AS "Company:Link/Company:220"
FROM `tabFR Trial Balance Entry` t
INNER JOIN `tabGL Group Mapping` gm 
    ON t.gl_account = gm.gl_account 
    AND t.company = gm.company
INNER JOIN `tabAccount` acc
    ON t.gl_account = acc.name 
    AND t.company = acc.company
WHERE t.company = %(company)s
  AND t.fiscal_year = %(fiscal_year)s
  AND t.month = %(month)s
  AND gm.report_type = %(report_type)s
GROUP BY acc.report_type, t.gl_account, gm.primary_group, gm.secondary_group, t.month, t.fiscal_year, t.company
